missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Молодость' is a feminine soft-sign noun in the nominative, the subject of 'проходит'. 'Быстро' is the adverb of speed.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Молодость' has the same form in the accusative for this third-declension noun, the direct object of 'вспоминает'. 'Свою' agrees in the feminine accusative.

missions.phrase: У него уже нет прежней молодости.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Молодости' is genitive after 'нет'. 'Прежней' agrees in the genitive, and 'у него' shows possession.
Strategic focus: Dative case. 'Молодости' is dative after 'благодарен', the thing he is grateful to. 'Своей' agrees in the dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Молодостью' is instrumental after 'гордится', the thing he is proud of. 'Бурной' agrees in the instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of time. 'Молодости' is prepositional after 'в', meaning during youth. 'Много' quantifies the travel.
Strategic focus: Prepositional after 'о'. 'Молодости' is prepositional after 'о', the topic of conversation. 'Часто' adds frequency.
Strategic focus: Genitive of belonging. 'Молодости' is genitive showing whose memories these are. 'Нашей' agrees in the genitive.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'с'. 'Молодости' is genitive after 'с', meaning since youth. 'Любит спорт' completes the habitual statement.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject with dative. 'Молодость' is nominative as the subject of 'дарит'. 'Людям' is the dative recipient and 'много сил' is the genitive object.
